summary: Centene Corporation filed a Form 8-K on October 8, 2026 disclosing an Item 8.01 notice of redemption for all remaining $568,664,000 aggregate principal of its 4.25% Notes due December 15, 2027. The redemption date is October 23, 2026, at 100% of principal plus accrued and unpaid interest. The Bank of New York Mellon Trust Company, N.A. serves as trustee under the December 6, 2019 indenture. After redemption, no 2027 Notes remain outstanding. This is a routine corporate liability-management action, not a shareholder special situation; watch for potential refinancing or balance-sheet implications.
